transformation.name: within_dag_independent_service_permutation
transformation.algorithm: sort target task IDs by SHA-256(seed, graph key, task ID, a0-target), then assign the original node-order service sequence

before.definition: Criticality is membership in the trace-derived weighted critical path. Popularity is the global request count of the assigned service. Services 1-3 form the original hot group.

after.definition: Criticality is membership in the trace-derived weighted critical path. Popularity is the global request count of the assigned service. Services 1-3 form the original hot group.
